verdict.rationale: Netlify documents serverless functions, but nothing in the pack covers sub-second boot or cold-start times, or autoscaling instances to tens of thousands under load. "Deploy in seconds" refers to deployment speed, not instance boot time, and the only edge-function mention comes from a third-party integration listing (Turso), not Netlify's own capability. Edge compute is a fair axis for a hosting platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load
